sentences.en: Many companies design products with planned ______ so customers must buy new ones.
sentences.zh: 許多公司刻意設計產品的計畫性淘汰,讓顧客必須購買新品。

sentences.en: The rapid pace of technology has led to the quick ______ of old devices.
sentences.zh: 科技快速的發展導致舊裝置很快就被淘汰。

sentences.en: He began to ______ over every small detail of the presentation.
sentences.zh: 他開始對簡報中的每一個小細節都感到困擾。

sentences.en: Fans continue to ______ over the mystery ending of the film.
sentences.zh: 影迷們仍持續對這部電影神秘的結局感到著迷。

sentences.en: Installing the new software will ______ the need for manual data entry.
sentences.zh: 安裝這套新軟體將消除人工輸入資料的需要。

sentences.en: Early planning can often ______ many of the problems that arise later.
sentences.zh: 及早規劃通常能消除許多之後才會出現的問題。

sentences.en: The couple's ______ wedding featured gold decorations and a fifty-tier cake.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻的婚禮極盡奢華炫耀,佈滿金色裝飾,還有五十層的蛋糕。

sentences.en: He drove an ______ sports car just to impress his coworkers.
sentences.zh: 他開著一輛炫耀十足的跑車,只為了讓同事刮目相看。

sentences.en: The ______ waiter kept complimenting every dish the guests ordered.
sentences.zh: 這位諂媚的服務生不斷讚美客人點的每一道菜。

sentences.en: His ______ behavior toward the boss made his coworkers uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 他對老闆諂媚奉承的態度讓同事感到不自在。

sentences.en: The flood threatened to ______ the entire village.
sentences.zh: 這場洪水威脅要將整座村莊夷為平地。

sentences.en: Years of erosion have almost ______d the ancient carvings.
sentences.zh: 多年的侵蝕幾乎已將這些古老的雕刻抹去。

sentences.en: The book references an ______ 19th-century poet few have heard of.
sentences.zh: 這本書引用了一位鮮為人知的十九世紀詩人。

sentences.en: The exact origin of the tradition remains ______.
sentences.zh: 這項傳統的確切起源至今仍不明朗。

sentences.en: The ______ reason for his visit was business, but he really wanted to see her.
sentences.zh: 他此行表面上的理由是公事,但其實他真正想見的是她。

sentences.en: The company's ______ goal was efficiency, though layoffs were the real motive.
sentences.zh: 這家公司表面上的目標是效率,但真正的動機其實是裁員。

sentences.en: The old book was filled with ______ symbols and rituals.
sentences.zh: 這本古書裡充滿了神秘的符號和儀式。

sentences.en: He was fascinated by ______ practices from a young age.
sentences.zh: 他從小就對神秘學的作法十分著迷。

sentences.en: The ______ waiter brought extra napkins without being asked.
sentences.zh: 這位樂於助人的服務生沒等人開口就主動送來了額外的餐巾紙。

sentences.en: Her neighbors were always ______, willing to lend a hand whenever needed.
sentences.zh: 她的鄰居總是很樂於幫忙,一有需要就會伸出援手。

sentences.en: The scandal brought public ______ upon the entire organization.
sentences.zh: 這起醜聞為整個組織招來了公眾的恥辱與譴責。

sentences.en: He faced widespread ______ after the leaked recordings surfaced.
sentences.zh: 在那些外洩的錄音曝光之後,他遭受了廣泛的公開責難。

sentences.en: He endured years of public ______ after the failed business venture.
sentences.zh: 在這次創業失敗之後,他忍受了多年公眾的責難與恥辱。

sentences.en: The whistleblower faced ______ from colleagues despite exposing the truth.
sentences.zh: 儘管揭發了真相,這位吹哨者仍遭到同事的辱罵與排斥。

sentences.en: He remained ______ despite his family's pleas to reconsider.
sentences.zh: 儘管家人苦苦懇求他重新考慮,他依然固執己見。

sentences.en: The ______ landlord refused to lower the rent even during hard times.
sentences.zh: 即使在艱困時期,這位頑固的房東依然拒絕降租。

sentences.en: The ______ toddler refused to eat anything green.
sentences.zh: 這個固執的幼兒拒絕吃任何綠色的食物。

sentences.en: His ______ refusal to apologize damaged the friendship for years.
sentences.zh: 他固執地拒絕道歉,讓這段友誼受損多年。

words.defn_en: old; outdated, as in no longer in use

sentences.en: The old computer system became ______ within just a few years.
sentences.zh: 這套舊電腦系統在短短幾年內就變得過時了。

sentences.en: Many manual jobs have been made ______ by new technology.
sentences.zh: 許多人工工作已因新科技而被淘汰。

sentences.en: She preferred an ______ style of decoration, nothing too flashy.
sentences.zh: 她偏好低調不張揚的裝飾風格,不喜歡太過花俏的東西。

sentences.en: The security cameras were designed to be ______ yet effective.
sentences.zh: 這些監視攝影機的設計既不張揚又能發揮效用。

sentences.en: It would be ______ not to notice the tension in the room.
sentences.zh: 沒注意到房間裡的緊張氣氛,實在太遲鈍了。

sentences.en: His ______ comments showed he hadn't understood the presentation at all.
sentences.zh: 他遲鈍不得要領的評論顯示他根本沒聽懂這場簡報。

words.defn_en: a person who seeks self-gain, even at the expense of others, without regard to values or moral principles

sentences.en: The politician was criticized as an ______ who changed his views to win votes.
sentences.zh: 這位政治人物被批評是個為了贏得選票而不斷改變立場的投機者。

sentences.en: He was seen as an ______, taking credit for work he hadn't done.
sentences.zh: 他被視為一個投機者,把別人做的工作攬功在自己身上。

words.defn_en: to confuse, bewilder, or make unclear:

sentences.en: The professor's complex explanation only served to ______ the topic further.
sentences.zh: 這位教授複雜的解釋反而讓這個主題更加令人困惑。

sentences.en: Politicians sometimes use jargon to ______ their real intentions.
sentences.zh: 政治人物有時會使用術語來掩蓋他們真正的意圖。

words.defn_en: the act of making something unclear or difficult to understand:
words.root_note: ob- (over) + fuscare (to darken), from Latin fuscus (dark)

sentences.en: Critics accused the report of deliberate ______ regarding the true costs.
sentences.zh: 評論家指控這份報告在真實成本上刻意含糊其辭。

sentences.en: The contract's dense legal ______ confused most readers.
sentences.zh: 這份合約中晦澀難懂的法律措辭讓大多數讀者感到困惑。

sentences.en: The contract ______ him to pay.
sentences.zh: 這份合約要求他必須付款。

sentences.en: Their agreement ______ both parties to complete the project by June.
sentences.zh: 他們的協議要求雙方必須在六月前完成這項計畫。

words.defn_en: diverging from a straight line or course, not straightforward:

sentences.en: He made only an ______ reference to the scandal without naming anyone.
sentences.zh: 他只間接提及了這起醜聞,並未指名道姓。

sentences.en: The building's roof was designed at a striking ______ angle.
sentences.zh: 這棟建築的屋頂被設計成引人注目的傾斜角度。

words.defn_zh: 令人討厭的/惹人反感的

sentences.en: His ______ jokes at the dinner party embarrassed everyone at the table.
sentences.zh: 他在晚宴上開的討人厭的玩笑讓在座每個人都感到尷尬。

sentences.en: The neighbor's ______ behavior finally led to a formal complaint.
sentences.zh: 這位鄰居惹人反感的行為最終導致了一份正式投訴。

words.defn_en: the state of being clouded, obscured, or confused:
words.root_note: ob- (over) + nubilare (to cloud), from Latin nubes (cloud)

sentences.en: The medication caused temporary mental ______ in some patients.
sentences.zh: 這種藥物在部分病人身上造成暫時性的精神昏亂。

sentences.en: A thick ______ settled over the valley before the storm broke.
sentences.zh: 在暴風雨來臨前,一片濃厚的雲霧遮蔽了這座山谷。

words.defn_en: able to be seen or noticed:

sentences.en: The rings of Saturn were ______ through the telescope.
sentences.zh: 透過望遠鏡可以觀察到土星環。

sentences.en: There has been an ______ increase in customer satisfaction this quarter.
sentences.zh: 本季顧客滿意度出現了可觀察到的成長。

words.defn_en: quick to notice or perceive things; paying careful attention to details:

sentences.en: She was ______ enough to catch the mistake in the report before it was sent out.
sentences.zh: 她觀察力敏銳,在報告寄出前就發現了其中的錯誤。

sentences.en: The detective is very ______ of small details.
sentences.zh: 這位偵探對細微之處非常善於觀察。

sentences.en: The factory's ______ machinery was finally replaced last year.
sentences.zh: 這座工廠日漸過時的機器終於在去年被汰換了。

sentences.en: Fax machines have become largely ______ in most modern offices.
sentences.zh: 傳真機在大多數現代辦公室裡已經幾乎被淘汰。

words.defn_en: the branch of medicine dealing with childbirth and pregnancy:

sentences.en: She decided to specialize in ______ after delivering her first baby during medical school.
sentences.zh: 在醫學院期間接生了她的第一個嬰兒後,她決定專攻產科學。

sentences.en: The hospital's ______ ward welcomes over a hundred new babies each month.
sentences.zh: 這家醫院的產科病房每個月迎接超過一百個新生兒。

sentences.en: The teacher struggled to control the ______ classroom before the holiday.
sentences.zh: 假期前,這位老師難以控制這間喧鬧不已的教室。

sentences.en: The ______ crowd had to be calmed down by security before the show could continue.
sentences.zh: 這場表演必須先由保全人員安撫這群喧鬧的群眾,才能繼續進行。

sentences.en: We couldn't leave town because the road was ______ by fallen trees.
sentences.zh: 我們無法離開小鎮,因為道路被倒下的樹木堵住了。

sentences.en: Her view of the stage was completely ______ by the tall man in front.
sentences.zh: 前面那個高大的男子完全擋住了她看舞台的視線。

words.defn_en: to take up space or time:

sentences.en: The kids ______ themselves with games.
sentences.zh: 孩子們用遊戲來打發時間。

sentences.en: The army continued to ______ the border town for several years.
sentences.zh: 軍隊持續佔領這座邊境城鎮長達數年之久。

words.defn_en: to disagree with or resist strongly:

sentences.en: Local residents began to ______ the construction of the new highway.
sentences.zh: 當地居民開始反對興建這條新高速公路。

sentences.en: The senator vowed to ______ the controversial bill.
sentences.zh: 這位參議員誓言反對這項具爭議性的法案。

words.defn_en: resistance or dissent; a group opposing another:

sentences.en: The proposal faced fierce ______ from environmental groups.
sentences.zh: 這項提案面臨環保團體強烈的反對。

sentences.en: The ______ party criticized the government's new tax policy.
sentences.zh: 反對黨批評政府新的稅收政策。
